question: If Otto had been picked up by Subaru and the others first in Wrath If, I don't think things would have ended the way they did. What would have happened?
answer: Unfortunately, Otto's competence isn't something you can recognize at a glance. Subaru, who has fallen into a state of distrust toward other people in Wrath If, wouldn't be able to make good use of Otto, so I think it would eventually end with the coin landing on the other side somewhere along the way.
